verdict.rationale: The evidence shows llama.cpp ships a server (`llama serve`) and a built-in web UI that runs against that server. This implies the UI is a client of the same server interface, but the pack never documents the API surface or confirms that every UI action is reachable programmatically. missing for 10: explicit API documentation, confirmation of UI/API feature parity, endpoint coverage for model and session management, independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Built-in web UI against `llama serve` running Qwen 3.6
